learning_outcomes.text: Generate a draft deck from a brief or an existing document with Copilot
Ground a deck in source files and understand grounding limits
Review and correct generated slides for accuracy and structure
Apply confidentiality and permission awareness in PowerPoint
Decide when to use Copilot versus building slides manually

integrative_case: A manager turns a Word brief into a draft deck with Copilot, grounds it in a data appendix, then reviews every slide for accurate figures and a coherent narrative before presenting.
